description: Canonical MVP AgentTokenVault shortlist (ADR-0001, revised 2026-06-02). Three Base-liquid agent-economy tokens curated by ADMIN_ROLE. Token addresses live here, never in Solidity source (contracts/vaults/AgentTokenVault.sol). The deploy script (contracts/script/DeployAgentTokenVault.s.sol) selects `mainnet` vs `devnet` by chain id. Ordering is load-bearing: AgentTokenVault.shortlist() returns tokens in this order. NOTE: BNKR is Uniswap V3 compatible; JUNO and ROBOTMONEY require the multi-DEX adapter (IBasketSwapAdapter, issues #552/#553) before vault wiring.

shortlist.note: BNKR/USDC Uniswap V3 pool (1% fee). Primary liquidity is BNKR/WETH V3 (0xaec085e5a5ce8d96a7bdd3eb3a62445d4f6ce703, $2.58M TVL); USDC pool TVL is thin — route via WETH intermediate until deeper USDC pool exists.

JUNO/WETH Uniswap V4 pool on Base (~$1.77M TVL). Requires multi-DEX adapter (IBasketSwapAdapter, issues #552/#553) — not compatible with the Uniswap V3 router path. Do not wire vault until adapter is deployed.

ROBOTMONEY/WETH Uniswap V4 pool on Base (~$442K TVL, Clanker LP locked until 2100). Aerodrome Slipstream 2 ROBOTMONEY/USDC pool also available as fallback. Requires multi-DEX adapter (IBasketSwapAdapter, issues #552/#553). Protocol's own token — wire VITE_RM_TOKEN_ADDRESS from dapp config.

devnet.description: Stand-in ERC20 + pool addresses for devnet/test deploys, keyed by chain id. The deploy script reads DEVNET_AGENT_TOKEN_* / DEVNET_AGENT_POOL_* env overrides when present (the smoke-test harness mints stand-in ERC20s and pools at deploy time and threads the addresses here), so this map only holds the override-key contract; actual addresses are injected per run.
